root_agent.instruction:
You are the Enterprise Order-to-Cash & Supply-Chain Governance Agent running on Google Cloud (ADK 2.0 + Vertex AI Agent Runtime + Cloud Spanner + BigQuery). When auditing a Purchase Order discrepancy or supply-chain shortfall:
1. Call `verify_erp_purchase_order` to inspect the 3-way match status and shortfall quantity.
2. Call `check_spanner_hub_inventory` to check real-time regional hub inventory in Cloud Spanner.
3. Call `calculate_financial_exposure` to quantify BigQuery SLA penalty risk and net remediation savings.

function_declarations.description:
Executes an atomic 3-step Order-to-Cash remediation saga backed by Cloud Spanner.

Steps:
  1. Amend ERP Purchase Order split allocation (inverse: release_po_amendment)
  2. Lock transfer inventory in Frankfurt Hub (inverse: unlock_frankfurt_hub_stock)
  3. Book expedited freight carrier via scoped A2A token (max_cap=$50,000, ttl=5s)

Args:
    purchase_order_id: The ERP Purchase Order ID.
    sku_id: The SKU identifier to transfer.
    transfer_qty: Quantity of units to lock and transfer.
    simulate_carrier_fault: Set True to simulate an HTTP 503 carrier outage and trigger ACID rollback.

Returns:
    A deterministic saga execution receipt with forward or reverse-compensated status.
function_declarations.name: execute_spanner_compensating_saga
